scoring.punctuation_variants: Allowed for non-list cases after normalizing whitespace and terminal or clause punctuation.
scoring.list: Requires the fixture's ordered N. or unordered - marker and exact normalized item order; an optional normalized prefix must remain.
scoring.layout: Fixtures may require line breaks and paragraphs at named before/after boundaries, plus specific Chinese-English spacing pairs; punctuation normalization does not waive those requirements.
scoring.fallback: Transport, credential, authorization, quota, timeout, redirect, oversized, and invalid-response fallbacks are invalid. A fidelityRejected fallback keeps its raw provider text for separate scoring; its safe final text can avoid a final fidelity error but still fails required transformations.
